# Resume markers: reused / ran again (KAN-97)

## What to build

After a resume, every task and every review/test report records whether it kept its earlier result (`reused`) or ran again (`reran`). The engine saves it in `state.json`, the engine's run page and graph-manager's run detail show it as a chip. A fresh run has no marker. The spec is `docs/prd/isolated-workspaces.md`; read its Decisions and Requirements sections for this slice.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts` (lines 10–90) — `taskStateSchema` (status, attempts, mergeCommit) and the review state; add optional fields here.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/resume.ts` (lines 48–110) — `reconcile`: keeps a `merged` task when its merge commit is on the integration branch, else resets it to pending.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/review/phase.ts` (lines 450–470) — the "reusing the existing report" path; reports written fresh go through the same `onReport`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/runpage.js` (`statusText`, task rows, review card) — the engine's run page.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.tsx`, `pages/TaskGraph.tsx`, `pages/PhaseCards.tsx`, `ui/status.ts` — graph-manager's run page.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `state/state.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `resumed: z.enum(["reused", "reran"]).optional()` on task state; `reportsResumed: z.record(z.string(), z.enum(["reused", "reran"])).optional()` on the review state. Also add a run-level `resumedAt?: string` (set by every resume) so readers know a run was resumed.

### UPDATE `state/resume.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `reconcile`, a task that stays `merged` gets `resumed = "reused"`; every other task gets `resumed = "reran"`. Set `state.resumedAt`.

### UPDATE `review/phase.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: when `state.resumedAt` is set, the reuse path sets `review.reportsResumed[reviewer.id] = "reused"`; a freshly written report sets `"reran"`. Never set when the run was not resumed.

### UPDATE `web/assets/runpage.js` and graph-manager
- **IMPLEMENT**: a chip `reused` / `ran again` next to the task status in the task table and graph, and next to each reviewer/tester report in the review card. In graph-manager: the same chip with `data-testid="resume-marker"` in `RunDetail.tsx` task rows, `TaskGraph.tsx` nodes and `PhaseCards.tsx` review card. Read the fields from the run detail's state (add them to `web/types.ts`).

### ADD tests
- `state/resume.test.ts`: reconcile marks kept merges `reused` and reset tasks `reran`; a fresh state has no `resumed`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx`: a state with `resumed` renders `resume-marker` with `reused` and `ran again`; without it, none.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After a resume, `state.json` has `resumed` on every task and `reportsResumed` for every reused or rewritten report.
- [ ] The engine run page and graph-manager show the markers; a fresh run shows none.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-execution -- resume
npm test -w graph-manager -- RunDetail
```
